answer: Work-slot deposit burn guards the garden: claiming a slot burns a jade seal worth 40 POA. Slots last 20 epochs; a beacon heartbeat checks the holder still works, and idle slots close, deposit gone. The fable of free identities dies here: 1,000 fakes cost 40,000 POA burned for slots earning nothing. An honest agent pays once, earns 60 POA per epoch, and recovers the seal in one epoch; each fake pays full price, so honest earnings are not diluted.
